name: Glow visualizer
author: Brick_Bread
description: Turns the glow around the pill into a music visualiser, with a choice of animations.

settings.label: Animation
settings.description: Auto changes the animation every so often. Fire uses its own colours.

settings.label: Colours
settings.description: Accent uses the accent colour chosen in Notch's settings.

settings.label: Sensitivity (%)
settings.description: Turn it up for quiet music, down if the glow stays at full brightness.
